## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant documentation updates.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage, or I explained why no new test is needed.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for credentials, private data, and generated runtime files.
- [ ] If canonical runtime files changed, I refreshed and reviewed their manifest hashes.
